scheme_name: Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme (CMCHIS)
description: Comprehensive health insurance scheme to provide cashless medical treatment to low-income families in Tamil Nadu.
benefits: Cashless hospitalization cover up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for listed medical procedures across empanelled government and private hospitals.

eligibility_rules.description: Annual family income must be ₹1,20,000 or less as per Revenue Department Income Certificate
eligibility_rules.source: TN Health & Family Welfare Dept G.O. (Ms) No. 314

eligibility_rules.description: Family must be resident in Tamil Nadu with name listed in TN Smart Family Ration Card

required_documents: Aadhaar Card of head of family and family members
Income Certificate issued by Revenue Authority (VAO/Tahsildar)
application_method: Enrollment at District Kiosk / District Collectorate or empanelled government hospital CMCHIS counter.
source_document: Tamil Nadu Health & Family Welfare Department Policy Note & CMCHIS Guidelines
